presentation.description: A simple auto-presser. Add one or more keys, each set to tap repeatedly (N times or unlimited, at a delay you choose) or hold down (timed or until stopped) - they all run at once, so you can e.g. hold one key while tapping another. Sends keys to FFXIV only and keeps working while tabbed out. Open with /autoclick.
presentation.summary: Auto-press a keyboard key a set number of times, or forever.
